display_names.not_animal_or_human: Not a real animal or human (object, scene or drawing)

rule: p = softmax(log(probs)/T). If argmax is an animal/unknown_animal and p[human] >= human_ratio * max(p) -> human. If argmax is human -> human (never rejected). Else if argmax is unknown_animal/not_animal -> that. Else if max(p) < confidence_threshold or max cosine similarity of the 'gap' embedding to the bank < similarity_threshold -> unknown_animal if p[unknown_animal] >= p[not_animal] else not_animal. Else argmax.
preprocessing: RGB, EXIF-rotated, 224x224 bilinear, raw 0-255 values; scaling to [-1,1] is inside the model.
